// Rust environment reads are configuration, not diagnostics.
if std::env::var_os("SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_RUST_TRACE").is_some() {
    eprintln!("SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_RUST_MISMATCH field={field}");
}
if env::var("SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_RUST_MODE").is_ok() {}
if var_os("SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_IMPORTED_TRACE").is_some() {}

// JavaScript environment reads and comparisons consume names without emitting them.
const trace = process.env.SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_TRACE;
const optionalTrace = process.env?.SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_OPTIONAL_TRACE;
const bracketTrace = process.env['SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_BRACKET_TRACE'];
if (error.code === 'SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_REFERENCE') recover();
if ('SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_REVERSE_REFERENCE' !== error.code) recover();
switch (error.code) { case 'SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_CASE_REFERENCE': recover(); }

// Object/error construction remains an emission site.
throw Object.assign(new Error('refused'), { code: 'SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_JS_EMITTED' });

// diagnostics-registry: reference-only
const ambiguousCatalogEntry = 'SNAPBACK_FIXTURE_MARKED_REFERENCE';
